from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudicialDocument(BaseModel):
    """A single parsed judicial document with its identified cause category."""
    document_identifier: str | None = Field(description="The unique identifier for the document (e.g., '判决文书 1')")
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》' or specific judgment title)")
    legal_cause: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause category identified within the document text")
    candidate_causes: list[str] | None = Field(description="A list of potential cause categories found in the document, for inference agent matching")
    legal_type: str | None = Field(description="Broad legal category (e.g., 'Administrative', 'Civil', 'Criminal', 'Execution')")
    case_summary: str | None = Field(description="Brief summary of the case facts and ruling outcome")
    key_keywords: list[str] | None = Field(description="Keywords extracted from the document that support the cause classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for parsed judicial documents."""
    documents: list[JudicialDocument]
